  ◉ lume  /  a quiet place for curious minds                                    
 ╭─ Lume · field guide · / search · j/k scroll · Esc close ───────────────────╮ 
╭│/ resize                                                                    │╮
││1/5 matches · n/N next/previous · Esc clear                                 ││
││  Ctrl-w +/-      Resize by two columns; custom splits use two percentage   ││
││points                                                                      ││
││                  Also >/<. Collapsed siblings never absorb the resize.     ││
││                  Nested minimum sizes keep Articles visible when space     ││
││permits.                                                                    ││
││  Ctrl-w c / a    Collapse focused panel / expand article notes             ││
││  :panel NAME     Toggle library, articles, reader or annotations           ││
││  :panel-focus NAME       Expand and focus a panel                          ││
││  :panel-move left|right  Reorder focused panel                             ││
││  :panel-resize +4        Columns in classic layouts; percentage points in  │╯
││splits                                                                      │╮
││  :panel-close    Collapse focused panel, including Reader and notes        ││
││  Every panel has a [−] button. Top [+] buttons reopen hidden panels.       ││
││  All panels may be collapsed. Tab then restores the reader.                ││
││  Space c / :compact      Switch headline density                           ││
││  Space z / :zen          Center the reading column                         ││
││  Z / F11 / :fullscreen   Expand article to the whole terminal              ││
││  Esc             Leave fullscreen or cancel visual selection               ││
││  :width 82       Prose width, 40–140 columns                               ││
││  :fullscreen-width 80    Centered fullscreen text, 40–140 columns          ││
││  :justify on|off  Visually justify prose; copied text stays unchanged      ││
╰│                  Code, tables, headings and final paragraph rows stay      │╯
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
